notes: Hotfix after live 0.8.6.1 test. UI no longer relies on invisible placeholder rows: the panel is built from the selected companion's actual capabilities, single actions expand to full width, and switching portraits rebuilds the layout for that companion. Combat recovery is hardened: if a hostile appears during PREBUFF/PREBUFF_FULL, queued prebuff actions are cancelled immediately; if a valid combat target remains while the engine action queue is empty, xai_combat is invoked immediately instead of leaving the companion idle. Combat core remains 0.7.10.7.
